pro_course_detail.title: English Proofreading (OFFLINE)
pro_course_detail.description:
Here's how it works:

1.) You will send me a message telling me the date by which you need your corrected document and the number of words.

*One hour lesson = up to 1000 words
Package of 5 lessons = up to 5000 words

2.) I will send you a lesson invitation.
IMPORTANT REMINDER: This lesson does not meet in person.

3.) Once you have accepted my invitation, you will send me your document (word, google, or pages doc) in 'messages' BEFORE 10:00 CET (Central European Time) on the day you need your document returned to you. I encourage you to send your document as early as possible.

4.) I will send your document back to you no later than 17:00 CET on the agreed upon day, provided that you have sent the document no later that 10:00 CET of the same day. If I have questions, I appreciate you being available within this time frame via iTalki or Skype chat. This will ensure that the document returned to you will not require further revision.

5.) Once you have received the proof-read document, you can confirm the lesson as having been completed.

6.) If you would like a face-to-face meeting to go over the corrections, this can be done by requesting an additional 30 minute Conversation lesson.

*Trial lesson requests will not be accepted. Thank you for understanding.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I know every student is different, so as a teacher I am very flexible in my method. If you prefer a structured course, I can provide that. If you prefer conversational practice, we can "go with the flow." I have noticed that lessons that are well-planned are more likely to give students a good starting point- this is preferred for beginners with very little experience in speaking English. Through structured lessons, we can create interest in a variety of topics, set goals and achieve objectives systematically. I have created lessons and can share textbooks during our lessons together.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Homework is optional so I do not require my students to do any, but I highly recommend it! The purpose of homework is to help reinforce what was taught in class. Homework is very helpful, not only to the student but also to the teacher. When I review homework, I assess student's progress and identify problem areas that we can continue to work on together in class.  With that being said, I know life can be busy so homework will only be assigned if the student would like the additional practice. The types of homework you can expect include: written homework (essays, letters, etc.) listening homework (videos, podcasts), test understanding of grammar through fill-in-blank

pro_course_detail.description:
Students will learn English, learn about the world, and learn about themselves through authentic content with a global perspective. 

This program uses authentic literature with science and social studies content to build content knowledge and develop English literacy through enquiry-based learning. Students work with the content to develop critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills needed to succeed in their academic studies. 

Students are provided with the skills and strategies to understand stories and literature, and to work with more complex texts that include facts and background knowledge with a focus on vocabulary, phonics, reading, writing, and conversations.

A comprehensive guide to English grammar with clear, simple explanations that are ideal for learners at all levels covering key grammar specified in levels A1-C1 of the CEFR, the international standard for language learning.

pro_course_detail.description:
We will use the textbook, Grammar in Context, to improve listening/comprehension, speaking, and reading skills. 

We will begin our lesson with a listening exercise spoken by a native English speaker. After listening, I will provide you with an opportunity to summarize the short text. This will improve your comprehension and speaking skills.  We will end each lesson practicing target grammar in various sentences related to various topics.

Hello, dear language learners!

My name is Juan and I am a native English speaker from Boston, Massachusetts, USA. After receiving my TESOL certification in 2020, I have been teaching English for the past four years and I have been loving every moment of it. 

I love to learn languages - my strongest second language is Spanish (believe it or not I am not a native speaker!) and now I am learning Italian for my wife's family :) 

I really enjoy hiking in nature, traveling to different countries, playing board games and video games, and reading books about history.
teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have over four years of professional English teaching experience. I began my career teaching English online for one year with Gabonese students through the US Embassy in Libreville, Gabon. I have also taught online on other language-learning websites as well and I currently teach English both on iTalki and for another company in Spain.

I am professional, energetic, and totally engaged and invested in the learning journey of my students. It is very important for me to create high-quality lessons that make me feel proud of my work and help my students achieve their desired results with English.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching methodology is designed with one person in mind - you, the student. I like to use several methodologies that bring out the greatest results in my students. In conversational classes, I use the direct method (full English immersion) so that students get to practice speaking the language and practice listening to it. My goal for conversational classes is to have my students speak for over 50% of the class time since this greatly increases your confidence and ability to speak English.

My grammatical classes focus a lot on grammar - but not so much that it is boring. I make sure to provide diverse activities and speaking exercises to keep the class both challenging and entertaining!

pro_course_detail.title: Speak on the Spot! Conversation Practice -  The Learn by Doing Method
pro_course_detail.description:
These sessions are for students who want a diligent one-on-one coach to help them increase their overall English fluency through casual conversation practice.

Learning a second language takes exercise - like learning a dance. In order to really get good at speaking English and not lose that ability (not forget "the moves"), it's important that you build muscle memory in your mouth by using the language frequently and consistently. Unfortunately, there are still many people around the globe who currently don't encounter enough opportunities in their day-to-day lives to practice English. 

Many non-native English speakers after reaching a certain level, never improve their communication skills, and in unfortunate cases, some even start to lose skills they had previously worked hard to gain. 

I enjoy helping students improve their own sentences by identifying and/or recalling sophisticated words and then getting them in the habit of incorporating those words into their speech.

Let's chat about topics of your choice unless you prefer Teacher Amelia to suggest some. During these conversations, Amelia will ask lots of questions so you will learn to use the English language spontaneously and practically rather than from a boring irrelevant textbook. We can discuss unfamiliar vocabulary words, and grammatical rules pertinent to your sentences.

If there's a specific topic you'd like to study, please let me know! I enjoy creating customized materials for my students, tailored to help them achieve their individual goals. Additionally, I've invested in an excellent online resource featuring hundreds of well-organized worksheets, including articles, videos, audio files, vocabulary exercises, and discussion questions. These resources can be utilized to keep our "free conversation" lessons centered around specific topics that interest and motivate you. I'm also eager to hear about your career and any personal life updates you'd like to share during our conversations.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have 8 years experience teaching English as a second language. I've taught children as young as 5, as well as adults. My online English teaching is mostly private one-on-one lessons with children and adults of all ages, backgrounds, and levels of English fluency. I like to use a conversational style to my lessons and make language learning as relatable to everyday life as possible. I'm always attentive to each student's unique background, strengths, interests and needs to tailor my lessons to their best interests.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My formal lessons will be fun and interactive listening, grammar, writing, and reading lessons. My informal lessons will be "free talk" sessions, where we will just practice having a conversation in English, then at the end of their time, go over any aspects of the student's language skills that they should work on, based on how they spoke in their conversation with me. 
Throughout all types of lessons though, my teaching style is communicative, as I believe this is the best way to apply language as a skill to real life situations that skill will be needed for. Putting language into context makes it much more easy and enjoyable for the student, thus helping them learn better.

pro_course_detail.title: General English - Speaking, Grammar, Listening, Vocabulary and Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Each lesson will contain one or more of each area (grammar, speaking, listening, writing, and vocabulary) and will be tailored to your needs all the while using interesting and relevant topics. I’ll always include tips, resources, and tools to help you reach your language goals. 

Grammar: Practice grammar structures and focus on the areas that are problematic for you and you’ll be given practice exercises and tools that help you grasp grammar concepts.

Speaking: Talk about your favorite topics and hobbies all the while focusing on your pronunciation, intonation, and word stress. Many English learners have a wide vocabulary but sadly aren’t understood because they lack understanding of word stress and intonation. 

Listening: Perhaps you can read and speak English well, but you struggle listening to a conversation. You’ll practice by listening to interesting short audio and video clips and then we will discuss the content. 

Writing: Whether you’re writing an email or an essay, I’ll help you develop your writing skills and focus on content, style, and punctuation. 

Vocabulary: Learning new words is essential as a language learner. In every lesson, you will be exposed to new words and discuss their meaning, range, and pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description: Want to have a conversation with a native English speaker? This class is for you. We'll have a conversation about interesting topics like travel, food, tech trends, and current events. In this class, you will do most of the speaking and I will give you helpful guidance on how to improve your pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation - Mock Interview/Resume/CV Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
As a Cambridge CELTA certified English teacher, I have helped thousands of students reach their language goals and improve their Business English. This is a comprehensive class which will prepare you for eithr a job interview or help you improve your resume/CV in English. How does it work? 

* Interview preparation: Before the class you will provide me with information about the position you are applying for and I will create mock interview questions for your field. I will "interview" you and help you improve your answers and fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: 🗣️💬 Customized Interview SIMULATION with Feedback, Coaching and Notes - Academic Interview, Job Interview, Medical Residency/Fellowship Interview
pro_course_detail.description:
The best way to prepare for an interview, is to have an interview simulation followed by an honest, expert opinion of where you’re doing well, where you can focus to improve, and strategies for improvement.  

Each interview simulation is personalized according to the interview for which you are preparing.  My goal is to put my client in a situation where they have to speak about themselves and their career exactly as they would in an interview.  

➡️➡️ Before your simulation - we'll be in touch via italki messages / email to speak about your interview.  A job description or program description will be required.  

➡️➡️ Simulation - We'll first spend a few minutes speaking about your real interview, we'll then spend about 40-50 minutes interviewing.  After that, we'll go through some feedback about your interview simulation.  

➡️➡️ Following the simulation - You will receive my written notes.  

The most important tip!  Relax!! Don't be nervous.  The objective of an interview simulation is to have an *imperfect* interview, so that I can give you actionable tips for improvement so that the real interview is a bit less intimidating.  

⚠️⚠️ If you have very little time before your interview, this is the best option for you. 

Questions?  Just write me a message!
